title: Analyzing Bias in False Refusal Behavior of Large Language Models for Hate Speech Detoxification
benchmark_measurement: Bias in LLMs' false refusal behavior when asked to detoxify hate speech targeting religious groups.
findings: LLMs disproportionately refuse to detoxify hate speech targeting religious groups in English datasets, with 'Religion' being one of the top three categories for false refusals. This bias varies across languages; for example, false refusals related to religion are relatively low in Chinese compared to other categories.
